subject: 酒楼茶肆
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate ONE isolated Qing northern Chinese architectural game sprite on TRUE RGBA transparent background. Realistic matte grey-brick, grey-tile, aged dark wood with fine detail and restrained natural colors. A two-storey northern tea house and restaurant, grey-brick enclosed lower walls, dark timber fine lattice windows upstairs, main grey tiled hard-gable roof with modest side wing, open front threshold reveals a few small wooden tea tables and ceramic teapots inside. No gilding, no courtyard mansion, no signboards. Footprint 12m east-west by9m north-south. CORRECT CAMERA is orthographic 2:1 dimetric. BOTH ground axes have identical absolute slope one vertical pixel per TWO horizontal pixels. The visible front/SOUTH edge runs from left corner diagonally DOWN RIGHT with slope EXACT +0.5. The visible right/EAST edge runs from front corner UP RIGHT with slope EXACT -0.5. No perspective. Width:depth is 12:9. South facade faces lower left. Do NOT make the right side steeper or longer than specified. Whole thin base rectangular parallelogram has all front,left,right vertices clear. Topmost roof below top margin. No text or signboards, people, background, thick pedestal, scenery, floor, sky, halo, glow, watermark. Light upper left and tiny contact shadow lower-right. Generous transparent padding. Match realistic sober historical game sprites, not cartoon or toy.
selection_note: 2候选选1；第1候选矩形底边清晰，第2候选平面凹凸且偏轴。
